scope: Primary literature for a stochastic geometric-pump formalism; verified via public original-paper pages on 2026-10-30. This is research input, not manuscript prose.
convention: Column probability vector, dot(p)=L p; L_ij is j-to-i rate. Edge e=(u,v) oriented u-to-v; j_e=L_vu p_u-L_uv p_v; incidence D has -1 at u,+1 at v, so dot(p)=D j. Energies in kBT units.

equations.name: Arrhenius detailed-balance parametrization
equations.role: Controls equilibrium occupancies independently of symmetric conductances; barriers change routing kinetics.

equations.name: Markov-chain matrix-tree stationary formula
equations.formula: pi_i=tau_i/sum_j tau_j, tau_i=sum_{T rooted at i} product_{(j->k) in T} L_kj
equations.role: Positive combinatorial representation; independent stationary-state verification and symbolic elimination.

equations.name: Reduced inverse adiabatic response
equations.role: Computable transport connection without stochastic simulation. The correction sign is PLUS with the stated negative-spectrum L convention.

equations.name: Stochastic geometric pumping connection and curvature
equations.formula: A_ea=c_e^T G partial_a pi; Q_e^ad=oint A_ea d lambda_a; F_eab=partial_a A_eb-partial_b A_ea
equations.role: A closed control loop maps to a directed transport vector; control orientation reverses leading pumped current.

equations.name: Cycle-space conservation and Hodge projection
equations.formula: D Q=0; P_cycle=I-D^T(DD^T)^+D; Q=C z for any cycle basis C
equations.role: Every periodic circulation lies in graph cycle space; bridge current is exactly zero; projection removes numerical continuity defects.

equations.name: No-pumping and pumping restriction
equations.formula: B(t)=B_0 implies Q=0; E(t)=E_0 implies periodic p(t)=pi and Q=0; dim allowed pumps constrained by driven-subgraph topology
equations.role: Exact design gate: a device must vary both occupancy and routing, and controls must touch appropriate loops.

equations.name: Schnakenberg entropy production
equations.formula: sigma(t)=sum_{e=(u,v)} (a_e-b_e) log(a_e/b_e), a_e=L_vu p_u,b_e=L_uv p_v; Sigma=integral sigma dt>=0
equations.role: Physical dissipation audit on one orientation per undirected edge. No factor 1/2 is needed in this convention.

equations.name: Green-Kubo thermodynamic friction metric
equations.formula: zeta_ab=beta integral_0^infty <delta X_b(0) delta X_a(t)>_pi dt; W_ex=integral dot(lambda)^T zeta dot(lambda) dt
equations.role: Riemannian cost of changing equilibrium energies, with constant-thermodynamic-speed optimal scheduling.

equations.name: Isoperimetric skew-curvature mode
equations.formula: x=a cos(theta)+b sin(theta); Q_w=pi a^T F_w b; S=pi(a^T M a+b^T M b); max |Q_w|/S=0.5 ||M^(-1/2) F_w M^(-1/2)||_2
equations.role: Elementary Rayleigh/isoperimetric reduction derived for this synthesis; related geometric stroke optimization is established. Must assume strictly positive M or constrain metric-null directions.
equations.attribution: The displayed singular-value identity is an elementary derivation for the proposed method, not claimed as an equation directly quoted from Tam-Hosoi.

equations.name: Tilted Floquet full counting statistics
equations.formula: L_chi,ij=L_ij exp(chi d_ij) for i!=j, diagonal L_ii unchanged; U_chi=Texp integral L_chi dt; psi(chi)=T^(-1) log rho(U_chi)
equations.role: One exact finite-time periodic operator determines long-time mean transport, variance, and large-deviation statistics.

design_notes: Barrier-only directions have d pi=0 and zero leading state-space entropy/friction cost. Use positive actuator metric M=zeta+eta R with eta>0, or hard barrier amplitude/speed bounds. Never claim total physical efficiency using particle entropy alone.
No-pumping is exact for periodic steady state. An arbitrary nonequilibrium initial state produces a transient integrated current that is not covered by the periodic zero-current conclusion.
For tilted generators, multiply off-diagonal jump terms by exp(chi d_ij) but retain original escape-rate diagonals; do not re-balance columns after tilting.
At finite driving rate loop reversal need not give exactly opposite integrated current. Antisymmetry is exact for the adiabatic geometric term; finite-rate discrepancy is measured.

Closed finite-state pumps produce cycle circulation. Reservoir-to-reservoir separation or useful mechanical work requires an augmented open/load model and is an application pathway, not already established by a closed-ring calculation.
The ten-equation ranking is a selection by compatibility, not a factual claim that these known equations have been neglected or that geometric stochastic pumping is new.
Research-source webpage word limits were 200 words each; summarize source-specific background concisely, derive the new synthesis in original language, and do not reproduce long source text.

derived_compiler_identities.definitions: W=diag(g), A=D W D^T, K=W D^T A^+, H=I-KD
derived_compiler_identities.current: j^ad=K(B) dot(pi(E)); Q^ad=integral K(B) d pi(E)
derived_compiler_identities.barrier_derivative: partial_{B_b}K=-H e_b e_b^T K on zero-sum inputs
derived_compiler_identities.mixed_curvature: F_{B_b,E_a}=-H[:,b]*(K partial_{E_a}pi)[b]; pure E-E and B-B blocks vanish
derived_compiler_identities.gate_rank: With all independent well controls available, rank local attainable cycle currents from S barrier gates equals rank H[:,S]=|S|-c(G\S)+1=beta1(G)-beta1(G\S).
derived_compiler_identities.proof_sketch: Differentiate K=W D^T A^+ on 1-perp. dK=(I-KD)dW D^T A^+; for one log-barrier dW=-g_b e_b e_b^T dB_b. Rank follows because ker H is im(WD^T), and gradients supported on S have c(G\S)-1 free component potentials.
derived_compiler_identities.relation_to_literature: Constructive representation of the established geometric pumping and pumping-restriction framework; use as a derived compiler architecture rather than claiming the pumping restriction itself is new.
derived_compiler_identities.numerical_sanity_check: 5-node/7-edge connected graph, DH max5.55e-16; all seven centered barrier derivative comparisons h=1e-5 agree at max2.91e-11.
